name: io.github.ianderso/gramps-evidence-mcp
title: Gramps Evidence
description: Read/write a self-hosted Gramps Web family tree where every fact carries a citation.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MCP_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Gramps Web API, e.g. http://gramps.example.org:5000.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MCP_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: A dedicated Gramps Web user with at least the editor role.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the TOML file listing reference GEDCOMs and the privacy setting.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MCP_EXPOSE_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set true to turn off living-person and private-record filtering of bulk output.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MCP_TRANSKRIBUS_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A Transkribus account (Scholar plan or above), for ocr_media's handwriting routes. Every page costs credits.

environmentVariables.name: GRAMPS_MCP_TRANSKRIBUS_PAGE_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Pages a calendar month ocr_media may send to Transkribus without the caller's per-call spend_credits. 0 asks every time.
